description:
These exterior sandstone wall tiles are natural stone tiles from Pak Clay's stone cladding range, used on boundary walls, house fronts, garden walls and feature panels.

## How they look
Natural sandstone typically has an earthy, textured face in warm sand tones, and no two pieces are quite the same. Laid together, the variation gives a wall a hand-finished look that suits both modern and traditional homes. It is a good way to lift a plain plastered boundary wall without the upkeep of paint.

## Where they work
- **Boundary and garden walls**, as boundary wall stone tiles along the street side.
- **House fronts and porch walls**, in bands or full panels.
- **Planters, stair side walls and gate pillars**.

Natural sandstone tiles are a long-standing exterior finish because the stone tends to age well in sun and rain. For a full facade or elevation, also see the [sandstone facade cladding tiles](/products/exterior-natural-sand-stone-wall-cladding-facade-tiles).

## Good to know
- Material: natural sandstone
- Use: exterior walls
- Category: outdoor stone wall tiles
- Size, thickness and coverage per square foot: confirm on enquiry

Sandstone is heavier than clay or ceramic, so fix it with a suitable exterior adhesive on a sound wall. Order the whole quantity in one go so the shade range matches, and mix pieces from several boxes as you lay. Our guide to [outdoor and front wall tiles](/blog/outdoor-wall-tiles-and-front-wall-tiles-for-house-exteriors) compares stone, brick and terracotta.

## See it before you order
Looking for outdoor stone wall tiles in Lahore? Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to judge colour and texture in daylight, then send your wall area and city for a dated quote. Browse all [outdoor stone wall tiles](/categories/outdoor-wall-tiles-stone).

faqs.q: What is the price of exterior sandstone wall tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the wall area, thickness, quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Do sandstone wall tiles need sealing?
faqs.a: Sealing is optional. A breathable stone sealer can reduce staining and dirt pick-up on exterior walls; ask your contractor which product suits your stone and climate.

faqs.q: Sandstone or split stone tiles for a boundary wall?
faqs.a: Sandstone gives a flatter, warm-toned textured face; split stone gives a rougher, deeper relief. Both suit boundary walls, so compare samples on site in daylight.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Exterior Natural Sand Stone Wall" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
